trigger: Before implementing the preregistered O1 single-load offline replay, audit the frozen eight-event development packages for temporal cadence, exact model tensors, sequential ORION state, calibration metadata, and renderer-native corruptions.

evidence.saved_camera_policy: one diagnostic frame every 10 model/control steps
evidence.native_motion_blur_constraint: The selected condition is produced by CARLA RGB sensor rendering; a clean saved frame cannot be converted into the same native observation offline.

decision.replacement_near_term_stage: prospective online native-ORION development screen after exact human visual approval
decision.reason: Capturing eight new full-rate sequential packages before screening would add eight ORION/CARLA route runs plus new recorder engineering. A small online development wave reaches the corruption-induced behavior question sooner and preserves the exact runtime implementation.

replacement_screen_rules.initial_wave_selection_inputs: frozen clean scenario family, actor dynamics, town diversity, and existing clean-valid status only; no corruption-conditioned ORION output

claim_boundary: This amendment rejects an infeasible replay assumption and selects a future runtime path. It contains no corruption-conditioned ORION result, failure induction, uncertainty evidence, or safety claim.
